description:
Outcome: gardener reports a problem with their allocated plot, from brief.md First version 4.
Scope: plain-text report, durable plot/season/household link and timestamp, idempotent submission and receipt/status. Excludes: attachments, chat and gardener email.
Acceptance: own allocated plot only; nonempty bounded text; repeated submit safe; report retrievable by coordinator; no reports without allocation.
Behaviour: safe escaping; accessible loading/empty/error/retry/success feedback.
Verification: validation, authorization and retry tests plus phone journey. Prerequisites: prototype checkpoint, passwordless access and allocation workflow. Assumptions: text reports sufficient.
title: Gardener problem reports
